## Objective
- Build a complete, playable old-school tabletop cricket game inspired by a felt-ground family game, updated with international and Big Bash team colours, men’s and women’s squads, an Adelaide Oval-style rotary scoreboard, touch controls, umpire signals, sound effects, music, and commentary.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a standalone vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with custom SVG ground artwork and synthesized browser audio; no external game assets or framework.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial game interface and styling with felt oval, wooden barrier, wickets, stick-figure players, team selectors, squad toggle, rotary scoreboard, commentary panel, umpire callout, and touch-friendly controls.
- Added team data for T20/international and Big Bash formats, timing-based shot mechanics, innings/target flow, commentary, umpire calls, and synthesized sound/music.

### Active
- Validate and fix the game implementation, then run it and inspect a current screenshot.
- Confirm delivery timing, shot controls, innings transitions, and sound toggle work in a browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Inspect `app.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` for bugs; run basic syntax checks.
2. Start a local server, test gameplay including first and second innings, and fix issues.
3. Save and inspect a current JPEG screenshot at a viewport ≤1280px.
4. Finish with a brief summary, including key assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete page structure and SVG cricket ground.
- `styles.css`: Responsive visual design and ball/umpire animations.
- `app.js`: Team data, game flow, timing-based shots, scoring, commentary, and audio.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A notable potential UI bug: the women’s squad toggle handler sets both labels to the same text (`MEN`/`WOMEN`) regardless of state; check/fix while validating.
- Gameplay uses up to 20 overs per innings and offers three shots: defend, drive, and loft.

  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url

  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page

Keyboard:

  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
